items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Rockstar Games
items.claim: Rockstar still lists November 19, 2026 for the current console launch.

items.title: Take-Two Fiscal Q1 2027 results
items.claim: Take-Two’s August fiscal outlook still names the November 19, 2026 launch for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — PlayStation
items.claim: PlayStation lists November 19, 2026 for PS5 and PS5 Pro and provides current edition and preload details.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Xbox
items.claim: Xbox lists November 19, 2026 for Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — US PlayStation Store
items.claim: The US digital PS5 Store page currently lists November 19, 2026 at 05:00 UTC.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — New Zealand PlayStation Store
items.claim: The New Zealand digital PS5 Store page currently lists November 18, 2026 at 11:00 UTC, which is November 19 local time.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Platforms, Editions, and Versions
items.claim: Rockstar Support lists PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, November 12 preload, a code-in-box physical version, and account-region terms.

items.title: GTA VI Limited-Edition DualSense controllers
items.claim: PlayStation announced limited-edition controllers with September 10 preorders and November 19 launches.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look — Now Playing
items.claim: Rockstar released the extended look as curated in-game footage captured on PlayStation 5.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is Now Coming May 26, 2026
items.claim: Rockstar moved the target from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is Now Set to Launch November 19, 2026
items.claim: Rockstar moved the target from May 26, 2026 to November 19, 2026.

items.title: GTA 6 PC Release Could Come Sooner Than Expected
items.claim: VICE relays an unofficial VGC signal about a potentially shorter PC wait; no date or window is provided.

items.title: When the heck is GTA 6 going to release on PC?
items.claim: PC Gamer offers an editorial forecast based on past port gaps while noting that no official PC window exists.

items.title: New GTA 6 leaked footage is actually years old, alleged leakers claim
items.claim: GamesRadar reports an unverified claim that some circulating clips are from 2023; no leaked material is reproduced.

items.title: Court grants Take-Two request in leak investigation
items.claim: Reported legal action shows an active infringement investigation but does not establish readiness or a date.

items.title: Fake GTA VI ISO claim
items.claim: Tom’s Hardware reports a purported ISO was described by social-media analysts as padded malware; this is a warning, not release evidence.

items.title: Final hearing in legal battle over GTA firings
items.claim: IWGB alleges Rockstar unlawfully dismissed 31 workers and says the final hearing runs from September 10 to October 16, 2026.

items.title: Rockstar employment tribunal report
items.claim: PC Gamer reported the tribunal timetable and that the allegations were allowed to proceed; no link to a release movement is reported.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look Soars to No. 1
items.claim: Netflix reports 31.1 million views and No. 1 in 87 of 93 tracked countries; this is attention context, not readiness proof.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Rockstar Store
items.claim: Rockstar’s Store still lists November 19, 2026 and publishes November 12 preload and code-in-box physical logistics.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — US PlayStation Store
items.claim: The US digital PS5 Store page still lists November 19, 2026 at 05:00 UTC.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — New Zealand PlayStation Store
items.claim: The New Zealand digital PS5 Store page still lists November 18, 2026 at 11:00 UTC, which is November 19 local time.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Xbox
items.claim: Xbox still lists November 19, 2026 for Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Take-Two fiscal Q1 2027 release filed with the SEC
items.claim: The filed publisher release still lists GTA VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and warns that timely delivery is an assumption.

items.title: Day 3: Rockstar Employment Tribunal
items.claim: Fresh reporting covers a contested tribunal argument about unannounced features; it does not report a release-date change.

items.title: Rockstar tribunal coverage
items.claim: The Independent reports on the live proceeding and competing interpretations without linking it to a current GTA VI schedule movement.

items.title: Miami Beach votes in favor of a GTA VI collaboration
items.claim: Local reporting describes a Miami Beach vote and negotiation around a reported GTA VI campaign; this is marketing context, not software-readiness evidence.

items.title: How Miami-area governments may market Grand Theft Auto VI
items.claim: CBS Miami distinguishes city promotional activity from the unresolved county question; it does not establish a release change.

items.title: Miami-Dade statement on reported GTA VI collaboration
items.claim: The county statement is a boundary against treating reports as proof of a formal Miami-Dade agreement with Rockstar.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Rockstar Games
items.claim: Rockstar still lists November 19, 2026 for the current PS5 and Xbox Series X|S launch.

items.claim: Xbox still lists November 19, 2026 for Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — US PlayStation Store
items.claim: The US digital PS5 Store page still lists November 19, 2026 at 05:00 UTC.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — New Zealand PlayStation Store
items.claim: The New Zealand digital PS5 Store page still lists November 18, 2026 at 11:00 UTC, which is November 19 local time.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Platforms, Editions, and Versions
items.claim: Rockstar Support still lists PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, November 12 preload, and a physical code-in-box version with no disc.

items.title: Announcing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
items.claim: Rockstar announced a 34-track GTA VI album for November 19, 2026, with six singles available and vinyl and CD pre-orders.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Music
items.claim: Rockstar’s album page says “Coming November 19,” lists 34 original tracks, and provides digital pre-save and physical pre-order links.

items.source_type: reported transcript of official shareholder meeting
items.title: Take-Two 2026 annual meeting transcript
items.claim: The September 17 meeting transcript records a November 19 PS5 and Xbox reiteration and general comments that PC is becoming more important; it announces no GTA VI PC platform, date, or window.

items.title: Take-Two says PC is becoming more important
items.claim: PC Gamer reports on Take-Two’s general PC strategy comments; the report does not provide an official GTA VI PC date or window.

items.source_type: reported hardware availability and buying guide
items.title: PS5 Pro restock and availability context
items.claim: Tom’s Guide reports PS5 Pro scarcity and above-MSRP listings and notes that Rockstar has not confirmed how GTA VI uses the Pro; scarcity is purchase context, not readiness evidence.
